skills.description: Decompose new 3D worlds such as buildings, aircraft, cities or robots into scalable subsystems, physical-domain contracts and validation gates. Use for system architecture and roadmap design; not for creating certified engineering plans.

Create or refine reusable procedural 3D parts in src/catalog.js and src/brick-system.js. Use for dimensions, meshes, material systems and printable component design; not as a substitute for manufacturing fit testing.

Design or audit mating anchors, holes, studs, shafts, hinge axes, face ports and tolerances in the 3D-world component system. Use when adding connectionProfile data, snap targets or connector semantics.

Extend the general rigid-body constraint graph, revolute/shaft/slider/fixed joints, loop closure or numerical kinematics. Use for assembly motion, graph validity, collision and solver performance; not for torque or CAD certification.

Plan and validate the physics readiness of 3D worlds, including materials, structural loads, rigid-body dynamics, collision fidelity, fluid/aero effects and environmental constraints. Use for physical-world claims, never to invent simulation outcomes.

Architect large multi-floor buildings and built environments as domain-separated 3D world systems. Use for building concept scenes, floor graphs, MEP, structural layouts and streaming; not for code-compliant design approval.

Design conceptual aircraft, aerospace vehicles and airport-world systems as modular visual and simulation requirements. Use for aircraft model architecture, subsystems, coordinate frames and readiness reviews; never for airworthiness claims.

Build and validate educational rovers and mobile robot assemblies using catalog parts and constrained chassis/wheel graphs. Use for six-wheel Mars rover concepts, wheel mounts, sensor payloads and robotics kinematics.

Turn Chinese/English natural-language build requests into catalog BOM, connection graph, joint parameters, ordered assembly steps and solver validation. Use when implementing or auditing the AI assembly Agent; never trust raw model-produced geometry.

Generate and review assembly/disassembly step dependency DAGs, exploded paths, and Three.js step animations. Use for instruction generation and subassembly ordering; not for claiming collision-free robot motion.
Review procedural meshes, schema stability, 3D asset performance, tests, documentation and GitHub Pages release readiness. Use for quality gates, asset import or production deployment.
Author, revise and validate reusable Agent Skills for Codex, Claude and Pi in the 3D worlds repository. Use for new skill modules, reference/script/asset contracts and skill metadata maintenance.
